def: The cost of an attempt divided by the share of attempts that succeed, so failed attempts are paid for too.
The delay between sending a request and receiving the first token of the reply, dominated by reading the prompt.
The set of configurations that no other configuration beats on every axis at once, such as quality, cost and latency.
A configuration that another one matches or beats on every axis and strictly beats on at least one, so it should never be chosen.
A component that sends each request to a model chosen by its estimated difficulty or type.
A routing rule that asks the cheap model first and escalates to the expensive model only when a confidence check fails.
Provider-side reuse of the model's computation on the start of a prompt, so a repeated prefix is read at a discount.
A cache keyed by an embedding of the question that returns an earlier answer to a similar question, with the risk of wrong or leaked answers.
The tokens you send to a model and the tokens it writes, which providers price at different rates.
The money lost when one answer is wrong, used with serving cost to decide what quality is worth paying for.
